# Brewing pour-over coffee

Filter coffee is three variables: how fine the grind is, how hot the water is, and how long they touch.

## Ratio

Start with fifteen grams of coffee for two hundred and fifty grams of water just off the boil, about ninety-three degrees.

## Tasting

Sour and thin means the water passed too fast: grind finer. Bitter and dry means too slow: grind coarser.
